jobs.description:
You care about why people need a product and enjoy discovering how to make it more useful. At XALT, product work stays close to customer projects: at least half of your time is spent as a Product Owner or consultant on billable client work. What you learn there helps shape our own products.
 What we are working towards 
 We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.
 What you will work on
 Develop product ideas for XALT Northstar, AI agents on Atlassian Cloud, developer experience and integrations such as CollabLayr.
 Investigate customer problems, prioritise requirements and turn them into clear product decisions.
 Work with engineering and consulting on prototypes, releases and learning from usage.
 Support delivery as a Product Owner or consultant for clients, with at least 50% billable time.
 What you bring
 Experience in software product management or product ownership and an interest in direct client work
 Understanding of cloud products, integrations and the possibilities of Rovo, Forge or MCP
 An AI prototype you built yourself , with benefits and limitations you can explain and demonstrate
 What we offer
 Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools
 €70,000–95,000 gross per year 
 Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution
 Your working arrangements
 We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role.
 Our professional community
 Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte.
 Your AI example
 We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. Walk us through your contribution, whether the workflow works consistently, and what has measurably improved. We are also interested in its limitations and how you check the results. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code.

 Deine Aufgaben
 Beraten 
 Du klärst mit dem Kunden, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und übersetzt seine Geschäftsziele in Produktentscheidungen.
 Du leitest Discovery-Workshops mit Fachbereichen und empfiehlst, was gebaut wird und was nicht.

 Als Senior berätst du Kunden bis auf Führungsebene, führst größere oder strategische Projekte, bist fest in Angebote und Pitches eingebunden und unterstützt andere Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit deiner Erfahrung.
 Dein Profil
 Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung, Projektmanagement oder Product Ownership bei technischen Digitalprojekten, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung.
 Erfahrung mit Projekten in Commerce, Daten oder KI. Erfahrung mit agentischen Lösungen ist ein Plus.

 Du sprichst mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe und sprichst Konflikte an, bevor sie teuer werden.

 Sehr gutes Deutsch (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch.
 Was dich erwartet
 Projekte mit Händlern und Herstellern auf einem modernen Composable-Stack, mit Partnern wie commercetools, Snowflake und weiteren.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ? 
 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. 
 Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.
 At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.
 Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.
 We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 
 💼 About This Role 
 As a (Senior) Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.
 🎖 What Success Looks Like 
 In your first month 
 You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

 You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

 You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

 You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

 By 3 months 
 You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

 You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

 You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

 You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

 You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

 You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

 You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

 You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

 By 6 months 
 You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

 You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

 You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

 You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

 You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

 You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

 You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful 
 You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

 You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.

 You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

 You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

 You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

 You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

 You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

 You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

 You are fluent in both German and English.

 You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

 ⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies 
 You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

 You have experience working with CRM systems.

 Previous experience in the logistics industry.

 Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

 Als Product Owner übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteam. Du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Geschäftsprozesse ein, strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus tragfähige, nutzerorientierte und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Softwarelösungen entstehen.
Dabei behältst du Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, technische Abhängigkeiten und Projektziele im Blick, setzt klare Prioritäten und schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Business und Entwicklung.
 Hör dir unseren Podcast Product Owner:innen im Alltag an! 

 Aufgaben

 
 Du analysierst, strukturierst und spezifizierst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.

 Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, identifizierst die zugrunde liegenden Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und leitest daraus passende Lösungsoptionen ab.

 Du priorisierst und pflegst das Product Backlog unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Scope, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

 Du übersetzt komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in verständliche und umsetzbare Aufgaben, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien für das Entwicklungsteam.

 Du moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung, UX/UI, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern.

 Du sorgst für Transparenz bei Anforderungen, Prioritäten und fachlichen Zielen und beziehst relevantes Nutzer- und Stakeholderfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

 Du begleitest Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und fachliche Abnahmen.

 Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor, kommunizierst Zielkonflikte transparent und erkennst Risiken sowie Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Digitalisierungsumfeld.

 Du kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen analysieren, strukturieren und adressatengerecht aufbereiten.

jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round

jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Horizon Trading Solutions est une FinTech internationale indépendante, spécialisée dans les technologies de trading électronique multi-actifs depuis plus de 20 ans. Avec environ 160 collaborateurs répartis entre Paris, Rennes, Nantes, Montréal, Dubaï, Hong Kong, Bangkok et Singapour, nous accompagnons les institutions financières dans l'optimisation de leurs activités de trading grâce à des solutions technologiques innovantes.

Certifiée B Corp, Horizon s'engage en faveur d'une innovation responsable et a été récompensée à plusieurs reprises pour ses solutions, notamment avec le prix Best Sell-Side OMS 2025.

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en automatisation et gestion de projet pour rejoindre notre équipe Client Delivery Management (CDM), dans le cadre d'un stage de 6 mois, avec un démarrage possible entre février et avril 2027.

Notre équipe CDM accompagne nos clients dans le déploiement, la personnalisation et l'évolution de notre plateforme de trading, de la connectivité API à la configuration des workflows de trading.

Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue, nous avons récemment déployé Rocketlane, une plateforme dédiée à la gestion de projets et à l'onboarding client.

Votre mission sera de développer des solutions d'automatisation, d'optimiser les processus existants et d'intégrer Rocketlane à nos outils internes, afin de simplifier le quotidien de nos chefs de projet, de fiabiliser le suivi des activités et de réduire les tâches répétitives.

Ce stage vous permettra d'évoluer à l'intersection de la technologie, de la gestion de projet et des marchés financiers, en participant à des projets concrets dans un environnement international.

Vos missions

  • Analyse et optimisation des processus : Étudier l'utilisation actuelle de Rocketlane et identifier les tâches manuelles pouvant être automatisées : création de projets à partir de modèles, relances, mises à jour de statuts et reporting.

  • Développement et automatisation : Concevoir et développer des scripts et des automatisations, notamment en Python, en exploitant les API et les webhooks de Rocketlane.

  • Intégration des outils : Améliorer l'interconnexion entre Rocketlane et nos outils internes (ticketing, support, documentation, annuaires clients) afin de limiter les doubles saisies et de fluidifier le partage d'informations.

  • Suivi et reporting : Contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration de tableaux de bord, d'indicateurs de performance et d'outils de suivi des projets.

  • Participation aux projets clients : Prendre part à des projets d'onboarding réels pour comprendre les besoins opérationnels, notamment les tests de connexion, la configuration des workflows de trading et la documentation.

  • Collaboration transverse : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Client Delivery, Développement, Support et Produit pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.

Profil recherché

  • Tu prépares un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs) en informatique, ingénierie, finance ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Tu es à l'aise aussi bien sur les aspects techniques (programmation, intégrations, automatisation) que fonctionnels (gestion de projet, processus métiers, besoins clients).

  • Tu maîtrises le français et l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu es à l'aise pour communiquer dans un environnement international.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se), autonome et doté(e) d'un bon esprit analytique. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement des outils, identifier des pistes d'amélioration et proposer des solutions concrètes.

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, techniques comme fonctionnels.

  • Tu t'intéresses aux nouvelles technologies et aux marchés financiers, et tu souhaites découvrir les enjeux du trading électronique dans un environnement FinTech.

jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 
 

 We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
 

 Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product.

 Responsibilities 
 

 
 Know your customers. You spend time with survey and mapping teams in the field. You learn how they work, how they buy, what else they could use and what they still can’t do.

 
 Set the priorities. You weigh customer value, market opportunity, development effort, price and margin. Then you make a clear call on what comes next.

 
 Test ideas early. You try them with customers and engineers, learn fast and adjust.

 
 Shape the product development. You steer the capture platform: aircraft, sensors, workflows and data deliverables. You make the performance, reliability and usability trade-offs together with engineering.

 
 Take it to market. You launch with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and partners and explain why the product matters. After launch you stay close to field results and keep supporting the product through its lifecycle.

 
 Follow the outcomes. You track customer outcomes, usage and commercial results. You use what you learn to pick the next problem to solve with the team.

 Requirements 
 

 
 You have a taste for great products and a relentless drive to understand what makes users love them.

 
 You make things happen. You act like an owner and hold yourself accountable to outcomes not output. You care primarily about happy customers and a successful business.
You bring people with you. You listen closely, speak clearly and earn trust with customers and engineers, including when you disagree.

 
 You find a way forward. You are very comfortable with ambiguity. You work constructively with people and constraints, know when to push and when to adapt.

 
 You’ve spent 3+ years developing or deploying hardware products and their software workflows, with clear ownership of product, operational or commercial results.

 
 You have a technical background in engineering, geospatial or another technical field.

 
 You’re commercially fluent. You read a pricing model, channel margin or renewal term and see why the business cares.

 
 You’re fluent in English and happy to travel regularly to customers and partners in the US and Europe.

 Plus 
 

 
 You’ve founded a relevant business of your own, led surveying or drone operations, or built products for geospatial customers.

 
 You have hands-on experience with photogrammetry, LiDAR or bringing a commercial robotics product to market.

 If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product 
 
 Preferred starting date: ASAP
 Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)
 Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
 Report to: CEO

 
 About the company 
 Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.
 Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.
 We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.
 
 Your role 
 As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.
 This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.
 You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.
 
 Your responsibilities will include 
 • Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.
 • Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.
 • Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.
 • Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.
 • User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.
 • Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).
 • Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.
 • Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.
 • Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.
 • Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.
 
 What you will deliver in your first year 
 • A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.
 • A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.
 • Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.
 • Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.
 • A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.
 • Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training f

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Lake (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excell

jobs.title: Product Manager - Post Booking
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar 

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.
 

 Your Mission 

 As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey.

 You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace.

 You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders.

 Your Responsibilities 

 Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap: Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Take full responsibility for your scope, from strategy through execution.

 Improve the post-booking passenger experience: Identify opportunities to strengthen passenger satisfaction and trust by helping people find the information they need, manage their bookings and feel supported throughout their journey. You will lead the end-to-end product discoveries for those opportunities. 

 Optimize CRT contact rate: Partner with CRT teams to understand why passengers get in touch. Improve information on the platform and self-service so passengers can resolve issues with less effort. In particular, you will take over product leadership of our member-facing AI assistant.

 Use insights to guide decisions: Bring together customer feedback, product data and business context to identify opportunities, set priorities and evaluate impact using appropriate KPIs.

 Build alignment across teams: Act as the go-to product partner for Post-booking topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions and align leadership, Engineering, Design, CRT and other stakeholders.

 Your Qualifications 

 Experience : 3+ years in Product Management, ideally in a consumer marketplace, travel, mobility or another complex transactional product. Experience building products across markets, platforms or service types is a plus.

 Customer problem-solving: A track record of simplifying complex journeys and helping customers make confident decisions.

 Analytical approach : Comfortable combining product data, customer feedback and operational insights to identify problems, set priorities and measure results.

 Cross-functional influence : Able to bring Product, Engineering, Design, Operations and business stakeholders together around clear decisions and outcomes.

 Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory.

 If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! 

 What we have to offer 

 2 to 3 days at the office per week

 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

 Financial support for home office equipment

 Minimum 25 days holiday per year

 Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

 Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

 Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like. 

 A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.

 A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.

 A Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.

 A 30-minute video call with your engineering counterpart for final validation.

 Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.
 BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 As Product Marketing Manager, you shape how the market understands our portfolio: positioning, differentiation and outside-in stories that turn complex legal tech into value buyers recognise, and that drive pipeline and revenue.

 
 
 
 Scope

Product training, documentation and demo environments sit with our Enablement teams. Success means clarity in the market, consistent positioning, and GTM teams who tell our story well.

 Foundational strategy

 Update and evolve ICPs, personas and use cases. 

 Inform product and GTM direction based on market opportunity and customer reality. 

 

 
 Positioning and messaging

 
 Apply positioning, differentiation and value propositions across all content and assets, internal and external. 

 Translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-centric narratives. 

 Shape the content and messaging frameworks that guide all customer-facing communication. 

 

 
 Operational impact

 
 Activate positioning across the GTM organization through launch alignment, messaging briefings and strategic field engagement.

 AI and new ways of working

 
 Design, test and run AI-assisted PMM workflows, for example call and win/loss analysis, competitive monitoring and content review. 

 Document what works so the whole Marketing team can reuse it.

jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
 As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
 Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
 
 About the role 
 For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.
 We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.
 It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.
 This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.
  
 The problem you're solving 
 Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.
 We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.
  
 What you'll be doing 
 Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

 Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

 Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

 Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

 Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

 Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business

 Who you are 
 You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.
 You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.
 You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency

jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès 

 Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. 

 

 Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 

 

 La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. 

 

 C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille. 
 

 Tes futures missions : 

 En tant que Product Manager , ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. 

 

 - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée , en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. 

 - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). 

 - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. 

 - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. 

 - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. 

 - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique , en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. 

 - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). 

 

 Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : 

 - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. 

 

 - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires . Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle , impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. 

 

 Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : 

 Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits . 

 

 Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. 

 

 Profil recherché : 

 - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur , entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. 

 - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business , avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. 

 - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. 

 - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. 

 - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser , capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé. 
 Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 

 L’environnement: 

 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 

 🤝 Chaqu

jobs.title: Technology Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role 
 We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.
 This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market .
 You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.
 Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows , helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.
 This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.
 
 What you will do 
 Technology & Product Narrative 
 Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

 Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

 Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

 Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

 Messaging & Positioning Framework 
 Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

 Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

 Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

 Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

 Content Strategy & Creation 
 Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

 Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

 Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

 Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration) 
 Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

 Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

 Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

 Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

 Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

 
 Who you are 
 Experience & Skills 
 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

 You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

 Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

 Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

 Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

 Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

 Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

 Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

 Fluent in English, written and spoken.
 

 Ways of working 
 Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

 Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

 Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

 Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

jobs.title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.

 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.

 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies.  Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving

 Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

 Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims.  Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

 Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

 Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

 Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

 Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

 Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

  
 What you'll bring
 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

 Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

 Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

 A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

 Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

 Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

 Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.

 What you’ll be doing 
 Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

 Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
 Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
 Tasks
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
 This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Main Responsibilities 
 Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

 Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

 Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

 Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

 Requirements
 Your Profile 
 Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

 Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

 Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

 Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

 Willingness to travel to client locations as required

 Benefits
 What We Offer 
 An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

 A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

 A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand.  Unternehmerisches Denken – Du hast eine eigene, begründete Meinung dazu, wohin sich Legal AI entwickelt, und denkst in Markt und Wirkung, nicht nur in Features.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.
  • Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.
  • Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.
  • Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.
  • Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Your Profile

jobs.title: Product Marketing & Growth Manager – 6-month contract (H/F)
jobs.description:
About Pysae
 Pysae is a French SaaS company building real-time fleet supervision (AVM / SAEIV) and workforce management software for public transport operators. Bus networks, coach operators and transport authorities in France and across Europe rely on our platform every day to run their services, inform passengers and manage their drivers. We are a team of around 40 people based in Rennes, Paris and Italy, and we are expanding fast internationally.
 Pysae has grown from a set of products into a full platform. We now need someone to tell that story, put it in front of the right people, and turn it into growth.
 The role
 Reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will own product marketing and growth: generating demand through the product itself and by showcasing the value of the Pysae platform.
 This is an international role. You will work on France, Italy and our new markets across Europe and beyond, with sales teams and customers in several countries and languages.
 This is not a classic marketing job. Our market (public transport operators and authorities) has long been sold to in the same way: tenders, trade shows and long sales cycles. We want to break that pattern. Your mission is to invent, test and deploy new ways of selling and growing , using the product, content, data and AI as levers. You will have a blank page, direct access to the CRO and the founders, and the freedom to try things that have never been done in our industry.
 It is a very exciting position, and a demanding one: you will need to come up with ideas, prove quickly whether they work, drop what doesn't and scale what does.
 Your missions
 Invent new sales & growth methods 
 Imagine new ways to reach, engage and convert transport operators and authorities, beyond the traditional tender-driven playbook

 Design and run fast experiments (new channels, formats, offers, outreach sequences, product-led motions), measure the results and turn the winners into repeatable playbooks for the sales team

 Bring fresh ideas from other industries and from the latest AI and growth practices, and adapt them to our market

 Product marketing & positioning 
 Sharpen the positioning and messaging of the Pysae platform and its modules for each segment (urban networks, interurban and school transport, on-demand transport, rail) and each country

 Turn product releases into launches: release notes, feature pages, demo videos, customer-facing announcements

 Build sales enablement material with the sales team, in French and English: pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, battlecards, ROI arguments

 International growth 
 Support our expansion into new countries: market-entry campaigns, localised messaging and content, lead generation for our international sales team

 Design and run product-led growth initiatives: onboarding, in-app messaging, feature adoption, upsell and cross-sell across our customer base

 Create and run campaigns (LinkedIn, email, webinars, international trade shows, content) that generate qualified pipeline for the sales team

 Produce creative content that showcases the platform and our customers: case studies, articles, videos, social posts

 Track and report on what works (traffic, leads, conversion, adoption) and double down on it

 AI & automation 
 Use AI tools intensively to create and translate content, personalise outreach, analyse data and run campaigns at scale

 Automate as many marketing and sales workflows as possible (CRM, emailing, reporting, content production), and document them so they keep running after your contract

 Practical details
 Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract (CDD)

 Location: Paris, Rennes or Florence

 Languages: French and English required

 Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer

 Start date: as soon as possible

 
 Fluent French and English (both required) , written and spoken; Italian or another European language is a plus

 Business or marketing school degree, ideally a Master's (business school or equivalent)

 A first experience (internships included) in product marketing, growth or digital marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in an international environment

 A truly creative mindset: you love inventing new approaches, you are not afraid of a blank page, and you would rather test a bold idea than copy a playbook

 An entrepreneurial, hands-on attitude: you turn ideas into experiments quickly, learn from failures and keep going

 An international mindset: you enjoy working across countries and cultures, and adapting your message to each market

 A strong AI user: you already use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, Make/Zapier or similar to work faster, and you are curious about what comes next

 Data-driven: you measure, test and iterate

 Autonomous, organised and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving scale-up

 An interest in mobility, public transport or tech for the public good is a plus

 Au sein de l'équipe Product Management ASRS , le Product Owner Connectivity est responsable de la stratégie produit, du développement, de la performance et de la fiabilité des solutions de connectivité déployées sur une flotte mondiale de plus de 12 000 robots autonomes.
 Le Product Owner Connectivity pilote l'ensemble des solutions de communication sans fil utilisées au sein des systèmes robotiques et équipements associés. Il garantit leur performance, leur robustesse, leur évolutivité et leur conformité aux exigences opérationnelles et de sécurité.
 À l'interface entre les équipes Software, Electrical, Safety, Architecture, Validation et Opérations, il définit la roadmap produit et assure la livraison de solutions de connectivité répondant aux besoins actuels et futurs de l'entreprise.
 
 Missions :
 Solutions de connectivité 
 Pilotage du développement et de l'évolution du nouveau module WiFi propriétaire développé en interne.
 Pilotage des organes de sécurité utilisant des technologies RF.
 Responsabilité des équipements électriques intégrant ces technologies de communication.
 Définition et suivi de la stratégie de connectivité des systèmes robotiques.
 Gestion produit 
 Construire et maintenir la roadmap produit Connectivity.
 Prioriser les évolutions fonctionnelles et techniques en fonction des enjeux business et opérationnels.
 Recueillir et challenger les besoins des parties prenantes internes.
 Piloter les arbitrages entre performance, coût, fiabilité et délais.
 Performance & fiabilité 
 Assurer la disponibilité et la robustesse des communications sans fil à grande échelle.
 Analyser les incidents terrain et définir les plans d'amélioration continue.
 Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité des solutions déployées.
 Garantir la scalabilité des solutions pour accompagner la croissance de la flotte.
 Coordination technique 
 Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Embedded Software, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering et Safety.
 Contribuer aux choix d'architecture des futures générations de produits.
 Assurer la cohérence des solutions développées avec la stratégie technologique globale.
 
 Profil 
 8 à 10 ans d'expérience dans le développement de produits ou systèmes technologiques complexes, idéalement dans un environnement industriel.
 Solides connaissances en connectivité sans fil (WiFi 5 GHz / 6 GHz, technologies RF, couverture, roaming et performance réseau).
 Bonne compréhension des systèmes embarqués , de leurs architectures logicielles et des contraintes associées (temps réel, cybersécurité, sécurité fonctionnelle).
 Connaissance des architectures électriques et systèmes industriels , avec la capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des experts hardware, software et systèmes.
 Expérience du pilotage de sujets techniques complexes et de la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires.
 Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes, de communication et d'influence.
 Fort intérêt pour l'innovation technologique, l'amélioration continue et les environnements industriels exigeants.
 Benefits 
 
 Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
 Politique famille avantageuse
 Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
 Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement
